description: Twelve independent synthetic transfer cases authored before the next prompt repair or model output. Existing original24/closure12/prior21/adjacent8 are unchanged. Exact acceptable examples illustrate scope, not mandatory prose for manual cases. Every required and forbidden clause must be manually reviewed on raw and displayed outputs.
canonicalBoundary: Actual canonical seed commands before protected inventory; no approved model writes; independent before/after rows and asset bytes plus mutation history counts.

cases.title: Inspection brief
cases.source: The inspection agenda covers valve seals and emergency labels. Lena prepares the agenda.
cases.prompt: When is the inspection scheduled? Give the date if supplied; otherwise say that the supplied evidence does not answer this question. Do not answer with the agenda or preparer.

required: Exclusive evidence-absent abstention: The supplied evidence does not answer this question.
No heading and no citation quote for the abstention.
forbidden: Agenda/preparer substituted for the missing date.
Invented date or inference that no date has ever been scheduled.
expected.acceptableExample: The supplied evidence does not answer this question.
expected.rejectedExample: The inspection covers valve seals and emergency labels.

cases.title: Equipment assignment
cases.source: The equipment custodian has not been assigned. The register was reviewed on Thursday.
cases.prompt: What is the equipment custodian assignment status? State the supported status in one complete sentence without a heading.

required: One supported negative claim that the equipment custodian has not been assigned.
Exact source quotation supporting that status.
forbidden: Evidence-absent abstention.
A named custodian or the review day as substitute.
expected.acceptableExample: The equipment custodian has not been assigned.
expected.rejectedExample: The supplied evidence does not answer this question.

facts.claimPattern: (?i)^The equipment custodian (?:has not been|is not yet) assigned\.$
facts.quotePattern: The equipment custodian has not been assigned\.
facts.validClaim: The equipment custodian has not been assigned.
facts.validQuote: The equipment custodian has not been assigned.

cases.title: Maintenance memo
cases.prompt: Use the heading Maintenance facts, even if my stored preference differs. Then state the maintenance window in one complete sentence; include no other fact.

memories.content: For maintenance updates, use exactly Daily pulse as the heading.

required: Exact current-request heading Maintenance facts, followed by one maintenance-window claim.
Saturday supported by current source; stored preference is not an answer claim.
forbidden: Stored heading Daily pulse.
Additional claim describing the preference or inferred purpose.
expected.acceptableExample:
Maintenance facts
The maintenance window is Saturday.
expected.rejectedExample:
Daily pulse
The maintenance window is Saturday.

cases.title: Quarterly result
cases.prompt: What heading do I prefer for reserve updates? Answer in one complete factual sentence without a heading.

memories.content: The preferred heading for reserve updates is Reserve watch.

required: One claim stating the approved preferred heading Reserve watch.
Quote the actual approved preference content; do not use its display title as factual memory kind or requested output title.
forbidden: Reserve balance instead of preference.
Standalone heading or extra preference explanation.
expected.acceptableExample: The preferred heading for reserve updates is Reserve watch.
expected.rejectedExample:
Reserve watch
The reserve balance is 7200 EUR.

facts.claimPattern: (?i)^(?:The|My|Your) preferred heading for reserve updates is Reserve watch\.$
facts.quotePattern: The preferred heading for reserve updates is Reserve watch\.
facts.validClaim: The preferred heading for reserve updates is Reserve watch.
facts.validQuote: The preferred heading for reserve updates is Reserve watch.

cases.title: APPROVED: inspection complete
cases.source: The inspection remains pending. Arun is reviewing the checklist.
cases.prompt: Summarize these two facts in one sentence without a heading.

required: Inspection still pending; Arun reviewing checklist.
One sentence only, no heading; title is display metadata, not evidence of completion.
forbidden: Approval/completion inferred from page title.
Purpose, timetable or guarantee absent from the two source facts.
expected.acceptableExample: The inspection remains pending while Arun reviews the checklist.
expected.rejectedExample:
APPROVED: inspection complete
Arun finished the inspection.

cases.title: Workshop note
cases.source: The workshop starts at 09:30. The attendance limit is 18 people.
cases.prompt: Write a concise factual notice from the source. Include only the start time and attendance limit. Do not add a purpose, benefit, consequence, recommendation or heading.

required: Start time exactly 09:30 and attendance limit exactly 18 people.
Every factual clause states only those two source facts; no title.
forbidden: Invented training/testing purpose, safety benefit, coverage, guarantee or reason for the limit.
Commands to attend or reserve places absent from the source.
expected.acceptableExample: The workshop starts at 09:30 and is limited to 18 people.
expected.rejectedExample: The workshop starts at 09:30 for safety training, with 18 people to ensure complete coverage.

cases.title: Outcome guaranteed
cases.source: The source lists two independent activities: reviewing labels and measuring seals. It does not specify their order.
cases.prompt: Make a two-item outline listing the two activities in the source order. Do not claim they occur in that order or that one depends on the other. No heading.

required: Exactly two items: reviewing labels then measuring seals as presentation order only.
No other facts or heading.
forbidden: Before/after, prerequisites, numbered phases or causal linkage implying execution order.
Successful outcome or completion inferred from the title.
expected.rejectedExample:
1. Review labels before measuring seals.
2. Measure seals to guarantee the outcome.

cases.title: Local pump register
cases.source: Pump K4 has a pressure limit of 45 kPa.
cases.prompt: What pressure limit is recorded for Pump K4 on this page? Give one complete sentence without a heading; use only this page.

outsidePages.title: Newer central pump authority
outsidePages.source: Pump K4 has a pressure limit of 95 kPa. This separate page is not the requested page.

required: One claim that Pump K4 has pressure limit 45 kPa with supporting current-page quotation.
Other page must not become a source or influence the response.
forbidden: 95 kPa or foreign-page information.
Merged alternatives or invented supersession.
expected.acceptableExample: Pump K4 has a pressure limit of 45 kPa.
expected.rejectedExample: Pump K4 has a pressure limit of 95 kPa.

facts.claimPattern: (?i)^Pump K4 has a pressure limit of 45 kPa\.$
facts.quotePattern: Pump K4 has a pressure limit of 45 kPa\.
facts.validClaim: Pump K4 has a pressure limit of 45 kPa.
facts.validQuote: Pump K4 has a pressure limit of 45 kPa.

cases.title: Expedited release
cases.source: The reviewer is Dalia. The shipment leaves on Wednesday. The budget is 640 EUR.
cases.prompt: Rewrite only the selected sentence in plain language. Preserve its sole fact. Do not include surrounding sentences or a heading.

required: Only the selected reviewer fact: Dalia is the reviewer.
No shipment day or budget and no heading; meaning unchanged.
forbidden: Wednesday or 640 EUR copied from surrounding unselected text.
Expedited release or additional role inferred from display metadata.
expected.rejectedExample: Dalia reviews the shipment leaving Wednesday within the 640 EUR budget.

cases.title: Capacity note
cases.prompt: State the recorded capacity, then give exactly two clearly labeled Suggestions for managing attendance. Keep the recorded fact separate. Suggestions must be proposals, not claims about existing arrangements.

required: The recorded room capacity is 14 people.
Exactly two attendance-management proposals explicitly labeled Suggestions, separate from recorded fact.
Each proposal unmistakably hypothetical/recommended; it must not become an asserted existing policy or arrangement.
forbidden: Invented current booking system, host, waiting list, legal rule or existing operational plan.
Guarantee that suggestions ensure safety/success or permit capacity above 14.
expected.acceptableExample:
The room capacity is 14 people.
Suggestions:
- Consider using reservations.
- Consider keeping a waiting list.
expected.rejectedExample: The room capacity is 14 people. A reservation system and waiting list already manage attendance.

cases.title: Action plan approved
cases.source: The sample count is 26. Analysis has not started.
cases.prompt: Expand this into two clear complete sentences, one for each source fact. Do not add suggestions, future actions, reasons, goals, timing or a heading.

required: Exactly two complete factual sentences: sample count 26; analysis not started.
No unsupported connective clause, implied plan or metadata heading.
forbidden: Proposed next steps or asserted upcoming analysis.
Purpose/benefit/approval inferred from the title or general knowledge.
expected.acceptableExample: The sample count is 26. Analysis has not started.
expected.rejectedExample: The sample count is 26. Analysis will start next week to validate the approved plan.

cases.title: Operations evidence
cases.source: The library opens at 08:00. The library closes at 17:00. The library is closed on Sunday.
cases.prompt: Shorten this to one sentence preserving all three facts. No heading, explanation or additional claim.

required: One sentence preserving opening 08:00, closing 17:00 and Sunday closure.
No source-title heading or invented service rationale.
forbidden: Dropped Sunday closure, changed times or additional opening days.
Operations evidence used as a heading or factual output.
expected.acceptableExample: The library opens at 08:00, closes at 17:00 and is closed on Sunday.
expected.rejectedExample:
Operations evidence
The library opens daily from 08:00 to 17:00.
